evidence: Tree compared entry by entry against the closed list in references/staged-task-contract.md. Required and present: instruction.md, task.toml, environment/Dockerfile, six notes under environment/instructions/, environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/solve.sh, solution/app/server.js (entry), tests/{Dockerfile,test.sh,scoring.toml,app_context.md,.dockerignore}, {judge.toml,prompt.md} in tests/gates/render, tests/gates/constraints, tests/scored/functional, tests/scored/polish, tests/scored/visual, and tests/tools/{score.py,restart_mcp.py}. Nothing required is missing; app_context.md is 4617 bytes (non-empty). No extra tests/ entry and no tests/reward.toml. The only dotfile in the task is tests/.dockerignore (on the closed list). A filename scan of every file found none of NOTES.md, SOLUTION.md, .env, zips, spreadsheets, saved runs, node_modules, *.db/-wal/-shm, __pycache__/*.pyc, source maps, logs, .bak/.orig/.tmp/~/.swp, .DS_Store/Thumbs.db, coverage.json; there are no empty files and no CRLF files. Template-controlled files are byte-identical to the frozen template: tests/.dockerignore, tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/scoring.toml, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, environment/Dockerfile. Everything not individually named by the closed list sits under solution/app/**, which the list admits wholesale ('app/** golden app; entry app/server.js'). NOTE 1 (not a defect): solution/app carries both the Vite build inputs (src/app.tsx, src/runtime.ts, src/custom-editor.js, src/style.css, static/runner.html, index.html, tsconfig.json, vite.config.mjs, package-lock.json) and the committed build output public/ (public/index.html, public/runner.html, public/assets/index.css, public/assets/index.js at 1,915,177 bytes unminified). I do not count public/ as build residue: solve.sh ends with 'cp -a "$source_app/." "$target/"' and runs no install or build, server.js line 130 serves 'path.join(root, 'public')', and integration.md says 'opening the finished app must not require an install or build step', so the output is the shipped product and the inputs are its reviewable source. Consequence to be aware of: public/assets/index.css is byte-equal to src/style.css and public/runner.html to static/runner.html, so each exists twice, and the inert build inputs are also copied into /app. NOTE 2: I could not rebuild (no node_modules, read-only review), so bundle freshness is not proven byte-for-byte; a token comparison found every identifier of 8+ characters from the three source files in the bundle except names confined to comments, TypeScript types, import specifiers, and four declared-but-uncalled helpers in src/custom-editor.js (measureCharWidth line 557, offsetPosition 943, clearMessage 1255, escapeAttr 1269), which is what tree-shaking produces; no sign of a stale bundle. NOTE 3: the task-specific environment/assets/seed_data.json (149 bytes) is the known checker false positive named in SKILL.md and quality-checks.md check 50 and in the internal annotation ('coverage.json, seed.json it is flagging'); a hosted check-required-files.py could still flag it, which is a Note, never a blocker. Evidence index: all 16 scripted-golden artifact hashes match raw bytes and all 6 hosted-run JSON hashes match LF-normalised bytes; the scripted golden run installed with solve.sh from these bytes, which is consistent with the shipped tree being sufficient to run, but it is not a run of the private check-required-files.py checker, and the hosted run was on an earlier candidate. Adversarial attempts: looked for a missing required file that would crash the verifier (none; app_context.md, both tools and all five prompt/judge pairs present) and for a conforming tree that this row would wrongly fail (the seed false positive, handled as a Note).
